body.p: Applicant thanks the Examiner for the indication that independent Claims 1, 9, and 17 are allowable subject to being rewritten to overcome the rejection under 35 U.S.C. § 112, set forth in this Office Action. Accordingly, the claims are amended to place the application in condition for allowance.

The Reasons for Allowance provided, beginning on page 2 of the Office Action, are acknowledged. However, Applicant does not take any position regarding the presented Reasons for Allowance other than those that may have previously been taken during prosecution. Therefore, the Reasons for Allowance should not be interpreted as being the sole basis for patentability of the claims. It is respectfully submitted that there may be additional reasons for patentability of the claimed subject matter that are not explicitly stated in this record, and no waiver of rights to such arguments is given by not further addressing those reasons herein.
Reconsideration and allowance in view of the foregoing amendments and the following remarks are respectfully requested.
Claims 1 - 29 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 5 112(b) as allegedly being indefinite.
Without acquiescing to the merits of the points of rejection but rather as part of a
cooperative effort to advance prosecution, Applicant currently amends Claims 1, 9, and 17 to address the points of alleged indefiniteness listed on pages 3 and 4 of the Office Action.
Accordingly, it is respectfully submitted that the present rejection should be withdrawn.

All objections and rejections having been addressed, it is respectfully submitted that the present application is now in condition of allowance, and early and forthright issuance of a Notice to that effect is earnestly solicited.

Should the Office find the application to be other than in condition for allowance, the Office is requested to contact the undersigned at the local telephone number listed below to discuss any other changes deemed necessary in a telephonic or personal interview.

It should also be noted that although arguments are presently submitted with respect to certain features or claims, the arguments are not necessarily exclusive of other reasons for patentability. Further, the lack of arguments herein to address any statement in the Office Action should not be interpreted as acquiescence or agreement with such statement. Applicant expressly reserves the right to set forth additional and/or alternative reasons for patentability and/or allowance with the present Application or in any other future proceeding, and to rebut any statement presented by the Examiner in this or other papers during prosecution of the present Application.
Dated: December 23, 2024 By: / David S. Lee /
